Scrap Drone.role: Disposable chaff that plates itself once, then lands hits that leave burn behind.

Rust Drone.role: Shields itself, nudges its own roll up, and shaves yours down with every hit.

Static Skimmer.role: Caps your next rolls with jam and shaves the rest down.

Patrol Enforcer.role: Plain heavy damage that starts stapling roll penalties on as it escalates.

Shield Enforcer.role: Attacks and shields in the same breath, keeping its whole line plated.

Heavy Warden.role: A durable bruiser that heals off its biggest hits and jams your dice.

Volt Enforcer.role: Plates its allies, punishes attackers with spike, and stacks burn on you.

Scrapmaster.role: Strips your shields, hits the whole squad, and heals for every Scrap Drone still standing.

Skitterling.role: Small and quick; it feeds on the damage it deals and leaves burn behind.

Bloodmite.role: The weakest thing on the field, draining a little HP back on every bite.

Spine Stalker.role: Opens behind spike armour, then stacks burns that outlast the fight.

Carapace Beetle.role: Hard to remove: it shields itself and its allies while burning you down.

Broodwarden.role: Feeds on the damage it deals and layers long burn on top.

Caustic Spewer.role: Copies your highest die, then hoses you down with heavy, long burn.

Hive Matriarch.role: Drags your rolls down, wipes your shields, and heals off the damage it deals.

Shard Drone.role: Fragile and simple: straight damage that only turns dangerous on a high roll.

Prism Charger.role: Pulls your attacks onto itself with taunt, then answers with rising damage.

Aegis Anchor.role: Holds the lattice up: shields its allies, lifts their rolls, and hides behind a firewall.

Resonance Warden.role: Heals itself, lifts its allies' rolls, and hits hardest at its peak.

Phaseblade.role: Straight, heavy damage, with a firewall up when it needs to survive.

Stormweaver.role: Lifts every ally's roll while stacking burn on your squad.

Relay Herald.role: Feeds shields and roll bonuses to its allies, and shrugs off one ability with a firewall.

Veil Overseer.role: Plates itself and its court, drags your rolls down, and wipes your shields at its peak.

Signal Wisp.role: Nibbles your rolls down and siphons Protocol out of your pool.

Circuit Acolyte.role: Hides behind firewalls, drains your Protocol, and rewrites a die to 3.

Cipher Scribe.role: Copies your highest die, rewrites another, and lifts its allies' rolls.

Oath Binder.role: A slow grinder: roll penalties, drained Protocol, and a die rewritten to 3.

False Image.role: Cloaks out of reach, wipes your shields, and takes your highest die for itself.

Ash Channeler.role: Winds up its own rolls, then lands the Synod's heaviest burn.

Signal Hierarch.role: Plates its line behind a firewall, then buries your rolls under penalties.

Pumice Climber.role: Weak alone, stronger for every other one of its kind still on the field.

Obsidian Hound.role: Hunts in a pack: every surviving packmate makes its bite land harder.

Slag Hound.role: The smaller pack hound, and it still hits harder the more of them are left.

Geode Panther.role: Opens from cloak and freezes your dice, so a bad result repeats.

Basalt Ape.role: Grows armour every turn, punishes attackers with spike, and strips your shields.

Cinder Raptor.role: Heals itself, pulls your attacks onto it with taunt, and leaves burn behind.

Magma Drake.role: Grows armour every turn and keeps you burning the whole fight.

Mantle Tyrant.role: Its armour never comes off; it doubles its own hits and freezes your whole tray.
